_meta.purpose: Book-wide applicability census: which research-ledger names expose PUBLIC scheduling/booking/reservation exhaust. This census IS the channel's APPLIES_TO surface over the book.
_meta.method: full sweep of desk/data/research_ledger.json (read-only) + hand-graded override table for every name with a plausible surface; default = 'no' with the generic reason. Regenerate after material book changes; `python3 -m desk.scheduler_exhaust --census-gaps` flags UNSCREENED names (UNSCREENED != CLEAR).

grades.indirect: exhaust exists but third-party-owned, diffuse, or gated
grades.no: no surface in the revenue chain

feasibility_scale.A: single public slot-level scheduler, panelable today
feasibility_scale.B: public surface exists; needs per-location panel + extractor work
feasibility_scale.C: gated/diffuse/thin — build only with a specific catalyst

_meta.confounder: slot scarcity conflates demand with CAPACITY (staffing up shortens waits while volume rises) — cross-check hiring_velocity before reading a scarcity move as a volume move

candidates.surface: patient service center draw-appointment scheduler — slot-level calendar per PSC
candidates.notes: LIVE INSTANCE #1 (lab panel, desk/lab_scheduler_panel.py — separate lane). Fixed PSC panel, weekly, fixed sampling slot. Calibration seed for the whole channel: Q2-2026 frozen calls, graded at the October Q3 prints.

candidates.surface: hotel booking-engine room availability/rates at Chamonix + American Place
candidates.notes: State gaming monthlies (already a desk watch: gaming_monthlies) dominate for casino revenue — booking adds only the hotel-occupancy angle. Build only if monthlies go stale or the hotel mix becomes the swing factor.

candidates.surface: published ER wait times on HCA hospital facility pages + CareNow urgent-care online web check-in (posted waits, ~175 clinics)
candidates.read_target: same-facility ER visits + adjusted admissions (reported quarterly)
candidates.notes: Queue-state postings rather than a booking calendar — same channel family (public operational queue exhaust). Panel a fixed CareNow cohort + facility ER pages. Capacity confounder is STRONG here (nurse staffing swings waits) — hiring_velocity cross-check mandatory. Best post-labs build: see candidates ranking note.

candidates.surface: Labcorp patient service center appointment scheduler — slot-level calendar per PSC
candidates.notes: LIVE INSTANCE #1 (same lab panel as DGX). Two-issuer panel = partial control for sector-wide demand vs company-specific share shifts.

candidates.surface: order-ahead quoted ready/promise times per store (Olo-powered ordering)
candidates.notes: Promise times are algorithmic floors off-peak — sample fixed PEAK windows only; throughput exhaust, not reservations (fast casual has no booking). Levered turnaround (smallcap_turnaround WATCH): a traffic read is decision-relevant.

candidates.surface: Supercuts/SmartStyle online check-in — posted per-salon estimated wait times across the franchise system
candidates.read_target: system same-store sales / traffic (franchisor royalty base)
candidates.notes: Thousands of homogeneous units = statistically dense free panel; metric is a minutes-queue (extractor variant), not days-to-next. Traffic inflection IS the classification_error thesis on this name — direct thesis-relevant instance.

candidates.surface: clinic-chain online booking (Japanese cosmetic-surgery clinics)
candidates.notes: Surface exists but verdict = TRAP-UNINVESTABLE (deep_value_scan5); census-only grade, no panel build.

candidates.surface: Rejuran/injectable treatment appointments at Korean/Asian clinics
candidates.notes: Provider-owned surface: the read is DIFFUSE — slot scarcity at a med-spa panel measures the spa, not the manufacturer's share vs competitors. Panel only with a curated product-heavy provider cohort; company-specific alternative = its own provider-locator COUNT (distribution growth, a different metric family).

candidates.surface: in-store party-booking calendars (small revenue slice)
candidates.notes: Party capacity rarely binds; comps are walk-in-driven. Thin.

candidates.surface: watch/jewelry boutique appointment booking (Cartier boutiques)
candidates.notes: Same policy confounder as Hermes; scarcity is managed as brand theater, which breaks the scarcity=demand mapping.

candidates.surface: test-drive / appraisal appointment booking per store
candidates.notes: Sales capacity almost never binds — scarcity carries no signal in normal times; appointment availability is kept deliberately open. Verdict AVOID.

candidates.surface: telehealth visit scheduling — slot picker sits behind account/payment gate
candidates.notes: Gated flow breaks free observation; most SKUs are async intake anyway.

candidates.surface: micro-hospital ER wait postings where facility sites show them
candidates.notes: Verdict AVOID (deep_value) — census-only grade.

candidates.surface: boutique appointment booking (leather-goods appointments, selected markets)
candidates.notes: Appointment POLICY shifts with clienteling strategy — policy confounder swamps demand; many boutiques are walk-in-only now.

candidates.surface: home-heating service appointment requests (form-based)
candidates.notes: No public slot calendar; weather dominates volume regardless.

candidates.surface: Starlink per-address availability/waitlist state (capacity-sold-out map)
candidates.read_target: Starlink subscriber adds / regional TAM unlock
candidates.notes: Coverage-capacity exhaust, not appointment booking; launch manifest is private. Different extractor family if ever built.

candidates.surface: some Tenet hospital ER wait pages; USPI ambulatory surgery scheduling is physician-office-gated
candidates.notes: The metric that matters (USPI cases) has NO public slot surface; hospital ER waits read the wrong (shrinking) segment.

candidates.surface: Thryv's SMB customers' public booking pages (Thryv SELLS the scheduling software)
candidates.notes: Counting live customer booking pages = product-ADOPTION census (footprint), not utilization — different metric family from slot scarcity; feasible but reads adoption.

candidates.surface: online ER/urgent-care check-in where deployed (InQuicker-style) at acute campuses; behavioral admissions are referral-gated with no public booking
candidates.notes: Coverage patchy across the fleet and the profit center (behavioral) is invisible to this channel — honest grade is thin.
